subject: Invoice INV-2026-001 from Acme Sh.p.k.
why: Subtotal 1000 + VAT 200 = 1200. The happy path: a row in the Invoices Log and a notification in the invoices channel.

subject: Invoice INV-2026-002 - Beta Consulting
why: 500 + 100 = 600, but the document says 700. Proves ADR-0002: the row is still written, with needs_review set and a review alert.

subject: Invoice discussion - meeting notes attached
why: Meeting notes, not an invoice. Exercises the ADR-0001 retry: first pass fails, the simplified prompt fails too, Extraction Failed Alert fires and no row is written.

subject: Fatura ne format teksti
why: text/plain is not in the Split Attachments allowlist, so Route by File Type sends it down the Unsupported slot. No Gemini call is made at all.

subject: Receipt from corner shop
why: A till receipt with no vendor id, no invoice number and no VAT line. Confidence lands below 0.6, and the missing tax is treated as 0 rather than as missing data — the case that motivated ADR-0002.
